purpose: Independent model-family diagnostic replication with SmolLM2; Qwen2.5 1.5B is the primary paired comparator and Qwen2.5 0.5B is secondary.

scoring.manual_audit: all distinct containment-positive/exact-negative candidate outputs and all primary reversal trajectories

paired_comparisons: SmolLM2 minus comparator accuracy and token F1 at each depth with paired bootstrap intervals
SmolLM2 minus comparator EAR@K and P-EAR with paired bootstrap intervals
discordant question counts and Jaccard overlap for any-reversal sets
question-clustered difference in adjacent-transition EAR and BCR
exact-match sensitivity for both prespecified comparators

hypotheses.primary: At least one harmful correct-to-incorrect transition occurs in the SmolLM2 condition.
hypotheses.comparative: Differences from the Qwen conditions are estimated two-sided; no direction is preregistered.

exclusions: No question is excluded based on its answer or effect on a metric.
A run may be replaced only for a documented technical failure, corrupted artifact, or protocol mismatch.
All 100 IDs must exactly match the published Qwen conditions and appear in the same order.
success_criterion: A complete, hash-verified 500-generation run plus primary and sensitivity analyses, regardless of whether the hypothesis is supported.
